Greetings, Agents

 

This is CM Fragment of the MARVEL Future Fight team.

 

We will be releasing an update that will fix some of the abnormalities experienced in our recent update.
This update will be released in each store.

 

We apologize again for any inconvenience caused by the various errors since this November update and for the long wait for this improvement update. We will do our best to quickly resolve any remaining issues.

 

You can play normally after the update.
The update availability in the store may vary from person to person.

 

For more information, please refer to the list below.
 

■ Improvements in the 12/03 Update

 

1. Optimized various aspects of the game and improved the overheating issue.

 

2. Fixed an issue wherein the effect of C.T.P. of Insight applied to Striker characters.
- All Agents will be able to Unequip Custom Gear at a 99% discount from 12/3 3:00 PM - 12/5 2:59 PM UTC+0, 12/3 7:00 AM - 12/5 6:59 AM (PST) as an apology to those Agents who experienced this issue.
Please note that a 100% discount is not possible due to the current development structure. Along with our apology, please accept the additional compensation listed below.
- (100) Selector: Biometrics X1 / Energy X100 / Boost Point X 50
* The rewards will be sent to your Inbox when you access the game on or before 12/8 2:59 PM UTC+0, 12/8 6:59 AM PST and will be stored for 6 days after receipt.

 

3. Fixed an issue in Alliance Battle where the crater that is supposed to show where the Meteorite collision happened was not shown properly.

 

4. Fixed an issue where the speech bubble would not display when playing in the World Boss Invasion stages.

 

5. Fixed an issue wherein Blade Twister effects that indicate where the ability will show up were unusually large in World Boss.

 

6. Fixed an issue where even after sending Assemble Points to your Friends or acquiring them from the [Friends] Tab, the Send All and Acquire All buttons were still active.

 

MARVEL Future Fight will strive to provide better service in the future.

 

Thank you.
